description: Get the videos, shorts and streams of a YouTube channel or playlist (or a single video by URL): title, description, views, likes, comments, duration, hashtags, subtitles and the channel's subscribers, total videos and views. 5 point per returned record.

download_subtitles.description: Download subtitles (when present on the video)

sort_videos_by.description: Sort channel videos by. Options: POPULAR = Popular, OLDEST = Oldest

subtitles_format.description: Subtitle format. Options: vtt = WEBVTT, xml = XML, plaintext = Plain text

subtitles_language.description: Subtitle language. Options: any = Any, de = German, es = Spanish, fr = French, it = Italian, ja = Japanese, ko = Korean, nl = Dutch, pt = Portuguese, ru = Russian

url.description: Channel (@handle or URL), playlist or video URL. e.g. @NASA

name: run_youtube_channel
title: YouTube channel
